title: Reflective check-in: vision-model output
description: Output of one vision-model turn. Guesses pre-fill the feeling chips only; the person's confirmed chips drive activity suggestions.

turn.description: 1 = drawing only; 2 = after the person replied in words.

observations.description: Concrete things visible in the drawing (turn 1) or said by the person (turn 2).

written_content.description: Words, letters or symbols the person wrote or drew on purpose, transcribed as seen.

reflection.description: 2 or 3 warm, tentative sentences. No diagnosis, no 'you are <feeling>'.

basis.description: The visible feature or the person's words this guess rests on.

feeling_guesses.description: At most 2 on turn 1, at most 3 on turn 2. Empty when insufficient_signal is true.

insufficient_signal.description: True when nothing emotionally specific is visible or said. Expected for most plain scribbles.

question.description: One open, non-leading question inviting the person to say how they feel.

safety_concern.description: True only if the person's words mention self-harm, suicide or not being able to stay safe.
